svg.title: Flare SM70 prefill and time to first token
svg.desc: Time to first token against prompt length on one Tesla V100 PCIe 32 GB, release binary d4ffb1fa, 2026-10-23, uncached prompts: 2,048 tokens: 2.54 s and 807 tok/s alone, 9.89 s and 796 tok/s aggregate with four; 8,192 tokens: 10.43 s and 785 tok/s alone, 41.44 s and 782 tok/s aggregate with four; 22,528 tokens: 30.39 s and 741 tok/s alone, 121.11 s and 741 tok/s aggregate with four; 30,720 tokens: 42.75 s and 719 tok/s alone, 170.49 s and 719 tok/s aggregate with four. Concurrent prefills do not overlap. Source: BENCHMARKS-SM70.md, prefill-summary.json.

svg.text: Prefill runs at 719–807 tok/s, one request at a time

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', 'Noto Sans', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four concurrent requests share it: all four first tokens arrive together, at about four times the single-request time.
